server_arguments.name: profile
server_arguments.label: profile
server_arguments.desc: Capability profile — determines which routes exist and what they accept. Built-ins mimic real vLLM-Omni models; each only lights up a subset of endpoints.

server_arguments.name: served_model_name
server_arguments.label: served-model-name
server_arguments.desc: Override the profile's model name in responses, without writing a whole profile for it.

server_arguments.name: seed
server_arguments.label: seed
server_arguments.desc: Seed for fake media generation. Same request + same seed always produces the same bytes.

server_arguments.name: latency_profile
server_arguments.label: latency-profile
server_arguments.desc: instant returns as soon as the fake can compute a response (fast CI). realistic streams tokens/audio/video at roughly the wall-clock rate a real model would, exercising TTFB and backpressure handling.

server_arguments.name: video_job_duration
server_arguments.label: video-job-duration
server_arguments.desc: Seconds a /v1/videos job spends queued (20%) then in_progress (80%) before completed. Defaults to 0.5s under instant or 4.0s under realistic if unset.

server_arguments.name: ws_timeout_scale
server_arguments.label: ws-timeout-scale
server_arguments.desc: Multiplies every WebSocket protocol timeout by this factor. 0 disables timeouts entirely; a fractional value shrinks them so a client's timeout handling can be tested without waiting.

server_arguments.name: max_generated_image_size
server_arguments.label: max-generated-image-size
server_arguments.desc: Makes /v1/images/generations and /v1/images/edits return 400 when the requested dimensions exceed this.

server_arguments.name: video_fidelity
server_arguments.label: video-fidelity
server_arguments.desc: Video output fidelity. canned (the only mode today) reuses tiny stock MP4s picked by closest aspect ratio, so duration/fps/num_frames in the response will not match what was requested.

server_arguments.name: forced_aligner
server_arguments.label: forced-aligner
server_arguments.desc: Pretend a forced-alignment model is loaded, enabling word_timestamps=true on the /v1/audio/speech/stream WebSocket.

server_arguments.name: enable_profiler_endpoints
server_arguments.label: enable-profiler-endpoints
server_arguments.desc: Force-register /start_profile + /stop_profile, overriding whatever the active profile set for enable_profiler_endpoints.

server_arguments.name: no_logo
server_arguments.label: no-logo
server_arguments.desc: Suppress the startup ASCII banner, for scripts that scrape stdout and choke on it.

arguments.name: temperature
arguments.label: temperature
arguments.desc: What sampling temperature to use, between 0 and 2. Higher values like 0.8 will make the output more random, while lower values like 0.2 will make it more focused and deterministic

arguments.name: top_p
arguments.label: top_p
arguments.desc: An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered

arguments.name: top_k
arguments.label: top_k
arguments.desc: The number of highest probability vocabulary tokens to keep for top-k-filtering

arguments.name: max_tokens
arguments.label: max_tokens
arguments.desc: The maximum number of tokens to generate in the chat completion

arguments.name: min_tokens
arguments.label: min_tokens
arguments.desc: The minimum number of tokens to generate in the chat completion

arguments.name: stop
arguments.label: stop_sequences
arguments.desc: Up to 4 sequences where the API will stop generating further tokens

arguments.name: presence_penalty
arguments.label: presence_penalty
arguments.desc: Number between -2.0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics

arguments.name: frequency_penalty
arguments.label: frequency_penalty
arguments.desc: Number between -2.0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim

arguments.name: logit_bias
arguments.label: logit_bias
arguments.desc: Accepts a json object that maps tokens (specified by their token ID in the tokenizer) to an associated bias value from -100 to 100. Mathematically, the bias is added to the logits generated by the model prior to sampling

arguments.name: ignore_eos
arguments.label: ignore_eos
arguments.desc: Whether to ignore the EOS token and continue generating tokens after the EOS token is generated.

arguments.name: use_beam_search
arguments.label: use_beam_search
arguments.desc: Whether to use beam search instead of sampling.

arguments.name: stop_token_ids
arguments.label: stop_token_ids
arguments.desc: List of tokens that stop the generation when they are generated. The returned output will contain the stop tokens unless the stop tokens are special tokens.

arguments.name: skip_special_tokens
arguments.label: skip_special_tokens
arguments.desc: Whether to skip special tokens in the output.

arguments.name: n
arguments.label: n
arguments.desc: number of answers to generate
